tool_args.rationale: The signatures and verified mechanism notes support the five-parameter coupled siphon-memory ODE, with horizon-conditioned readout. The current five rows leave genuine parameter-identifiability ambiguity, and the available extra_fine_trajectory_batch is the relevant probe to obtain the required trajectory observations before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter spatio-temporal siphon-memory ODE to the five current rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five-parameter coupled model is not adequately identified from only five observations; the mechanism notes call for at least eight.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not resolve the model’s trajectory-identifiability gap.
Neither probe is listed in the available cost menu; the observed s_grad range also does not establish the stated supercritical regime.
